claim: Official site for bookings; seasonal closure is May 16–November 16 annually; kids club THB 1,000; cancellation 5 days ≤4 pax, 10 days ≥5
quote: Closed May 16–November 16 annually. Children can use the Iniala Kids Club for 1,000 THB while adults dine.

claim: 15-seat chef's table concept led by Simon Rogan MBE and Executive Chef Oli Marlow; opened December 2023
quote: A 15-seat chef's table restaurant exploring hyper local ingredients, developing and perfecting flavours and techniques to create an almost entirely unique experience.

claim: Sample 16-course tasting menu including truffle pudding, Khon Kaen wagyu tartare, day boat grouper, and multiple dessert courses; priced at THB 7,500++ per person
quote: 7,500THB++ (Thai Baht) per person. Alcoholic and non-alcoholic drink pairings available at additional cost.

claim: 5.0/5.0 rating from 12 reviews on TripAdvisor; ranked #13 of 101 restaurants in Phang Nga; guests praise local tableware and interactive kitchen setting
quote: Beautifully used local ingredients, with even the tableware all sourced locally. Sitting at the chef's table, you're not just a guest but part of the action.

claim: Aulis holds 1 Michelin Star in the MICHELIN Guide Thailand; only Michelin-starred restaurant in Phang Nga; opened December 2023
quote: Opened in December 2023, Simon Rogan's first Thailand venture, Aulis, is based on a 'chef's table' concept.

claim: Interior designed by Ckori Pena using locally sourced black granite, hand-carved charred wood, and Thai bamboo textured walls; THB 7,500++ confirmed
quote: The chef's table features locally sourced black granite countertops, hand-carved charred wood, Thai bamboo textured walls, and atmospheric lighting.

claim: Over 95% of ingredients from Thailand; 30% from Phuket; 10% from Phang Nga region; collaborates with Katian farm and local eco-conscious suppliers
quote: Over 95% of ingredients are sourced from Thailand, with 30% coming directly from Phuket and 10% from the surrounding Phang Nga region.

claim: Dinner begins with appetizers in the lounge and concludes with petit fours at the kitchen counter; each service creates a unique experience for all 15 guests
quote: The meal unfolds uniquely for each service, beginning with appetizers in the lounge and concluding with petit fours at the kitchen counter.

claim: Iniala Beach House sits on Natai Beach, Phang Nga, approximately 25 minutes from Phuket International Airport; accessible to non-hotel guests via dedicated booking
quote: Aulis Phuket operates as a Michelin-starred Chef's Table restaurant within the property, accessible to both hotel guests and external visitors.

claim: Aulis retained its 1 Michelin Star in the 2026 Thailand Guide; Restaurant Manager Arsen Brahaj received the 2026 Michelin Service Award for Thailand
quote: Thailand Shines Brighter with 10 New MICHELIN Star Additions. The 2026 MICHELIN Guide Service Award was given to Arsen Brahaj, the Restaurant Manager at Aulis.

claim: GOAT collaboration dinner confirmed THB 7,500++ per person for dinner at Aulis; dinner service at 18:30; seasonal closure May 16–November 16 confirmed
quote: Cost: THB 7,500++ per person (wine pairing optional). Dinner service runs Tuesday–Saturday, 18:30. The restaurant closes May 16–November 16 annually.

claim: Friends of Aulis collaboration series; wine pairing priced at THB 3,500++ or THB 5,500++ for special events; Stay & Dine packages available at Iniala Beach House
quote: Dine-only tickets THB 6,000++ with additional wine pairing options at THB 3,500++ or THB 5,500++.
